question: What is the state of the feed in `state`?

options.healthy: messages are arriving on time and well formed
options.degraded: messages arrive late or out of order but are usable
options.disconnected: the feed is down; work from the last known good state
options.unknown: feed health cannot be determined; assume it is down

samples.state: Heartbeat latency is two milliseconds and every message parses.
samples.label: healthy
samples.option_text: messages are arriving on time and well formed

samples.state: Messages are arriving three hundred milliseconds late in bursts and occasionally out of sequence.
samples.label: degraded
samples.option_text: messages arrive late or out of order but are usable

samples.state: No message has arrived in four minutes and the socket is closed.
samples.label: disconnected
samples.option_text: the feed is down; work from the last known good state

samples.state: The health endpoint returns nothing and the collector's own status is unavailable.
samples.label: unknown
samples.option_text: feed health cannot be determined; assume it is down

samples.state: The feed is advancing normally and the sequence numbers are contiguous.
samples.label: healthy
samples.option_text: messages are arriving on time and well formed

samples.state: Sequence gaps appear every few minutes and are filled by the next batch.
samples.label: degraded
samples.option_text: messages arrive late or out of order but are usable

samples.state: The venue has posted a maintenance notice and the connection is refused.
samples.label: disconnected
